notes.title: Dark Mine Is Now Live — The Depths Are Waiting
notes.content:
[h2]The dark tunnels await you![/h2]
[h3]Cyber752 Games and Indie.io proudly present a dark tunnels nightmare, Dark Mine.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=uayWotB-4Q4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🔦 Key Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] 📷 [b]Night Vision Survival:[/b] No flashlight. No weapons. Just you, a drained camera, and the distant sound of something moving. Use your lens to reveal paths, and keep the shadows at bay.
[*] 🐾 [b]Monster That Hunts in Silence:[/b] You are not alone. The thing down here sees what you illuminate, and learns. Avoid detection, stay quiet, and don’t look back.
[*] ⛏️ [b]Retro PSX-Style Visuals:[/b] Winding tunnels, crumbling debris, and nowhere to run. Every corner hides danger. Hide before your doom finds you![/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602880/Dark_Mine/

[b][h3]You're support means the world!
[/h3][/b]As a small indie team, your support means the world to us. Here's how you can help:

[list]
[*] If you buy the game, [b]please consider leaving an honest review on Steam![/b]  
Reviews have a massive impact on indie games, and we'd love to hear what you think (and what scared you most 👀).
[*] Share the game with your horror-loving friends or post your reactions on social media.
[*] Join our growing horror community for behind-the-scenes peeks, theories, and future updates:  
[url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url]
[*] Follow for developer insights, updates, and analog horror content:  
[url="https://x.com/Cyber752Games"]🐦 Follow the Developer[/url]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Play Dark Mine on Steam![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602880/Dark_Mine/


Happy hiding,
[b]Cyber752 Games[/b]
